transfer.export.description: Packs actions, commands and timers into one import text (starting with CUEBOT1:) that you can share. Fails when a name is not found.

parameters.actions: Optional. Action names, separated by commas, like "Shoutout, Raid alert".
parameters.commands: Optional. Command names, separated by commas, like "!so, !lurk".
parameters.timers: Optional. Timer names, separated by commas.
parameters.includeDependencies: Optional. true (the default) also packs what they need, like actions they run. false packs only what you named.
parameters.name: Optional. A name for the pack, shown when someone imports it.
parameters.author: Optional. Your name, shown when someone imports it.
parameters.description: Optional. A short note about the pack, shown when someone imports it.

transfer.export.returns: The import text, starting with CUEBOT1:.
